title: 10. Exercises: Day 8 — LangChain Fundamentals: Build 2 Productivity Agents
summary: Add a fifth category Meeting-Invite and route calendar invites to it. Update both the Category enum and the system prompt.
objectives: Solve the Day 8 — LangChain Fundamentals: Build 2 Productivity Agents exercises without looking at the lesson
Test edge cases and explain your approach

sections.title: Exercises
sections.body:
1. **Add a fifth category `Meeting-Invite` and route calendar invites to it.** Update both the `Category` enum and the system prompt.
   <details><summary>Hint</summary>Add the new value to the `Category` enum and add an explicit instruction in the system message: "If the email contains a calendar invitation (.ics attachment mentioned or 'invite' in subject), classify as Meeting-Invite."</details>

2. **Persist the triage report to `triage.json` instead of (or in addition to) printing it.**
   <details><summary>Hint</summary>Use `pydantic`'s `.model_dump()` on each `EmailTriage` and `json.dump(..., indent=2)` the resulting list. Bonus: also write a CSV with the `csv` module.</details>

3. **Add a second LCEL step that drafts a reply for any email classified as `Action-Required`.** Chain the triage output into a second prompt.
   <details><summary>Hint</summary>Build a `reply_chain = reply_prompt | model | StrOutputParser()`. After triage, filter `results` to `Action-Required` and invoke `reply_chain` with `{"email": ..., "triage": ...}`.</details>
